name: std::array<T,N>::max_size
intro: Returns the maximum number of elements the container is able to hold.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Maximum number of elements, i.e. N.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Because each std::array<T, N> is a fixed-size container, the value returned by max_size equals N (which is also the value returned by size()).

summary: Returns the maximum number of elements the container is able to hold.
